sources.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
sources.snippet: Abstract. We present 4DAnyone, a framework for reconstructing 4D humans from an uncalibrated monocular video by generating reconstruction-grade multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS).

sources.title: 4DAnyone: From Monocular Video to 4D Humans - CCTest
sources.snippet: 4DAnyone generates multiview-consistent videos from uncalibrated monocular footage and uses RCP and TCR to support 4D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction.

sources.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
sources.snippet: Turns an uncalibrated monocular actor video into multiview-consistent novel-view videos and lifts them into 4D Gaussian Splatting assets. Introduces Reference Context Packing to keep reference conditioning fixed-size and Target Context Routing to exchange context across target groups, improving large-view reconstruction consistency.
